hook: Three Trezor wallets carried key-stealing implants — plus 4 more

items.claim: Three CryptoBilis‑sold Trezor Safe 5 wallets had implants designed to steal recovery phrases.
Microsoft's November Patch Tuesday fixed nearly 1,100 vulnerabilities, 63 rated critical.
Chrome's second update this week, 157.0.8103.78, fixes 83 security flaws, five rated Critical.
Check Point says attackers exploited a zero-day (CVE-2026-123039) for root access against a couple of dozen customers.
Microsoft’s Patch Tuesday fixed an Outlook flaw (CVE‑2026‑124194) already being exploited.

caption: Hardware implants can be built to capture a wallet's recovery phrase, while software patches keep browsers and email safe. This week’s fixes range from Chrome’s 83 fixes to a zero‑day root exploit. Which threat worried you more, the wallet implants or the Outlook flaw?
alt_text: Slide 1 says three CryptoBilis‑sold Trezor Safe 5 wallets had implants designed to steal recovery phrases; slide 2 says Microsoft's November Patch Tuesday fixed nearly 1,100 vulnerabilities, 63 rated critical; slide 3 says Chrome's second update this week, 157.0.8103.78, fixes 83 security flaws, five rated Critical; slide 4 says Check Point says attackers exploited a zero-day (CVE-2026-123039) for root access against a couple of dozen customers; slide 5 says Microsoft’s Patch Tuesday fixed an Outlook flaw (CVE‑2026‑124194) already being exploited.

es.hook: Tres carteras Trezor Safe 5 vendidas por CryptoBilis tenían implantes diseñados para robar frases de recuperación — y cuatro más
items: Carteras Trezor Safe 5: Tres carteras vendidas por CryptoBilis tenían implantes diseñados para robar frases de recuperación.
Patch Tuesday de Microsoft: El Patch Tuesday de noviembre corrigió casi 1 100 vulnerabilidades, 63 catalogadas como críticas.
Actualización de Chrome: La segunda actualización de Chrome de esta semana, 157.0.8103.78, corrige 83 fallas de seguridad, cinco catalogadas como críticas.
Check Point: Check Point dice que los atacantes explotaron una vulnerabilidad de día cero (CVE‑2026‑123039) para obtener acceso root contra un par de docenas de clientes.
Outlook: El Patch Tuesday de Microsoft corrigió una falla en Outlook (CVE‑2026‑124194) que ya estaba siendo explotada.
